messages.content:
Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

a 240 m long train running at the speed of 120 km / hr crosses another train running in opposite direction at the speed of 80 km / hr in 9 sec . what is the length of the other train ?

A. 260
B. 250
C. 240
D. 230
E. 220

message.content:
Relative speed = 120 + 80 = 200 km/hr = 500/9 m/s.

Distance covered in 9 s = (500/9) × 9 = 500 m.

Length of other train = 500 − 240 = 260 m.

ANSWER: A
message.reasoning_content: Relative speed 200 km/h = 55.56 m/s ×9 = 500 m → other = 260.
